summary: Cadeler plc filed a 6-K containing a stock exchange announcement that it will publish its Q3 2026 earnings release, covering the first nine months of 2026, at approximately 08:00 CET on 23 November 2026, with a live video webcast the same day featuring CEO Mikkel Gleerup and CFO Peter Brogaard Hansen from London. No transaction, stake, price, or board recommendation is disclosed. This is a routine earnings-notice filing, not a special situation; watch only for operational and backlog commentary on the offshore wind installation cycle.
